about: Phase 7 (prompts/phase-07-analysis.md step 5): the textbook Louvain example — two triangles joined by a single bridge edge. `analysis::communities::louvain` must keep each triangle together and must not let the bridge merge them; `analysis::communities::modularity` scores that partition strictly higher than the trivial one-community lump, which scores exactly 0.0 by definition (Newman's Q for one community is always 0 — the bug this fixture's own test caught: an earlier draft summed the null-model term only over existing edges instead of every same-community pair, which silently overstated Q for a lumped, sparsely-connected community).
